additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398635-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P7 170000791] Display issue CRM:01811000565
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
BayWA r.e. Operation Service GmbH
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P7 170000791
Charger ID/Serial No.:
DWaKE5
Problem Description:
Display issue
Please find attached an image of the charger, which appears to be displaying a scrambled screen. Kindly follow the Q feedback outlined below for further investigation.
SI E Q-Feedback Q2302 Sicharge D - HMI Backlight Off and Scrambled Image Due to R... - ID: 109816666 - Industry Support Siemens
We’ve also analyzed the logs, and based on our findings, it seems the power limit set from the SCB might be causing the power fluctuations that the customer is experiencing during charging.
However, the charger is currently delivering power without any fluctuations. We’ve attached the relevant log images for your reference.
Regarding the customer’s mention of a charging session on 30/12/2024, we have checked the logs for that day, and no charging session appears to have been logged. Please discuss this with the customer to clarify and address their concerns.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 7/8/2024 , as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
